name: barebars-monorepo
description: BareBars — a template-engine construction kit. PureScript monorepo: core library, CLI, and web playground.

scripts.test: spago test -p barebars && spago test -p kernel && spago test -p rawbars && spago test -p fullbars && spago test -p maxbars && spago test -p minbars && spago test -p fullbars-compile && spago test -p barebars-json && spago test -p barebars-js && spago test -p barebars-compile && spago test -p linter && npm run check:catalog && npm run check:isolation && npm run test:compile && npm run test:minbars-spec && npm run examples:verify && npm run check:tutorial-links && npm run check:bundle && npm run test:lab
scripts.examples:verify: spago build -p barebars-cli && spago run -p barebars-cli -- examples verify
scripts.test:lab: node reference/web/playground_utils.test.mjs && node reference/web/barebars.test.mjs && node reference/web/open-in-lab.test.mjs
